situation: The customer taps a notification (booking, door codes, SOS answer, message) while the app is still starting or while they are on Login, Registration or Password reset; the target screen is held back until they are inside the app.
old_where: NOT present in the released 4.1.3 look. In 70a94933 Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/push/notification_handler.dart:110-112 the tap was routed at once (dropped if the navigator context was null), and Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/push/push_service.dart (70a94933) :79-83 called the tap handler only if already set, while old main.dart:221-222 set the handler AFTER PushService.initialize, so a cold-start tap was lost and the app opened Home. The only login protection in 4.1.3 was the router redirect (Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/router.dart:228-258, _authRequired :180-200: /, /reservations*, /messages, /sos*, /payment, /booking ... -> /login). On this branch the waiting rule is Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/push/notification_handler.dart:139-157 (_deliverWhenReady: 240 x 500 ms = 2 min, waits while path is /login, /register or /reset-password) and :160-162 (_handleDeepLink), plus push_service.dart:32, :97-106, :115-123 (_pendingTap kept until setHandlers) and main.dart:287-291 (handlers set BEFORE initialize).
customer_sees: Nothing special: after logging in the app opens the target screen (detail, Messages, SOS). If the customer stays on the login screens for more than 2 minutes the tap is silently forgotten and they land on Home.
server: no (client navigation rule; the data behind each target is protected by RLS, and the router redirect still sends a logged-out customer to /login)
v2_where: Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/push/notification_handler.dart:139-197 has no MgV2 branch; v2 entry points: system notification tap (push_service.dart:54 onMessageOpenedApp, :61-62 getInitialMessage) and the v2 in-app banner 'Zobrazit' (notification_handler.dart:57-60 calls _handleDeepLink). Both go through _deliverWhenReady.
evidence: The waiting rule is shared code used by both looks; the v2 banner action (notification_handler.dart:57-60) and the OS tap (push_service.dart:97-106) both call _handleDeepLink -> _deliverWhenReady (:160-162). The router redirect (router.dart:228-258) has no v2 branch. Not determined: the onboarding overlays (language, permissions, intro) are drawn in MaterialApp.builder above the router (main.dart:507-529), and the onAuth check (:147-149) does not look at them, so a tap during first-launch onboarding may route underneath the overlay; this is identical in both looks.
visible_v2: silent (same as before; it is an improvement over 4.1.3, where the tap was lost)
fix_idea: No v2 fix needed. Optional for both looks: keep the pending tap beyond 2 minutes (until the first non-auth route) so a slow login never loses a door-code tap.

situation: A notification arrives while the app is open; the customer must notice it (especially issued door codes) and can open its target with 'Zobrazit'.
old_where: Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/push/notification_handler.dart:38-120 (old-look branch :66-119; in 70a94933 the same SnackBar at :38-94: door codes 8 s, green 1.5 px frame, green bold title, 4 body lines; other types 5 s, 2 lines; action 'Zobrazit' -> _handleDeepLink). Banner only exists when push is initialised: push_service.dart:44-45 returns before registering FirebaseMessaging.onMessage (:52) when notification permission is missing.
customer_sees: A floating dark banner: door codes = key emoji, green title, green frame, up to 4 lines, 8 s; others = envelope emoji, 2 lines, 5 s; green 'Zobrazit' action.
server: yes(trg_push_on_admin_message -> edge send-push; send-push skips when profiles.consent_push = false, the app locks consent_push = true during an active/upcoming paid booking per SUPABASE_BACKEND_STATE_5.md:227). The codes themselves also stay in Messages.
v2_where: Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/push/notification_handler.dart:47-65 (MgV2.peek branch) -> Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/features/shell/v2/push_banner_v2.dart:14-48 (SnackBar, duration :37 = 8 s / 5 s, neon 1.5 px frame :33-35), :86-94 (title neon for door codes, body maxLines 4 / 2), :98-113 (close X 44 px), :115-133 ('Zobrazit' 44 px -> onView).
evidence: Same trigger (PushService onReceived -> _showInAppBanner), same messenger (ScaffoldMessenger.of(root navigator context)), same durations (push_banner_v2.dart:37), same line limits (:91), door-code banner keeps a 1.5 px bright frame and a key tile, 'Zobrazit' calls the same _handleDeepLink (notification_handler.dart:57-60). v2 adds a close X. Small open point: lift = MgChromeScope.chromeOf(rootNavigatorContext)?.dockHeight (notification_handler.dart:62), but the root navigator context lies above the shell's MgChromeScope (core/v2/shell/app_shell_v2.dart:206), so lift is always 0; the banner relies on the shell Scaffold placing floating SnackBars above bottomNavigationBar (app_shell_v2.dart:270). I could not verify on a device whether the floating FAB layer or the hidden-on-scroll nav ever covers the banner.
fix_idea: None required. Optional: check on a device that the v2 banner is not covered by the floating buttons; if it is, read the dock height from the shell (e.g. a static notifier) instead of the root context.

situation: The customer taps a notification; the app decides which screen opens by the notification type.

customer_sees: The matching screen opens; for messages/door codes the notification is expanded and marked read (messages_screen.dart:36-39). A booking notification without id opens nothing. 'shop_order' opens the e-shop even when the eshop_visible flag hides the shop menu entry (profile_screen.dart:358) - this was already so in 4.1.3 (old notification_handler.dart:139). /shop is not in _authRequired (router.dart:180-200).
server: yes(type and id are set server-side by trg_push_on_admin_message / send-push; reservation and message data are protected by RLS, so a foreign id shows no data)
v2_where: Shared _route (notification_handler.dart:164-197, no MgV2 branch). Targets: /reservations/:id -> ReservationDetailScreen (router.dart:422-424) -> ResDetailV2View (features/reservations/reservation_detail_screen.dart:162-163); /messages?n= -> MessagesScreen(focusId) (router.dart:432-434), focus handled in shared initState (messages_screen.dart:36-39) and passed to MessagesViewV2 as expanded (:56-61); SOS gate shared (:124-134, hasActiveRentalProvider); /shop route (router.dart:392-396) shows the same ShopScreen.
evidence: Every branch is the same code for both looks; the only change on this branch is push -> pushOrGo (core/router.dart:142-153), which applies to both looks and avoids a doubled shell. The v2 banner's 'Zobrazit' reaches the same table (notification_handler.dart:57-60).
fix_idea: No v2 fix needed. Optional for both looks: respect eshopVisibleProvider for 'shop_order' (open Messages when the shop is hidden) and open Reservations when a 'booking' notification has no id.

In 4.1.3 (70a94933) the same permission and login conditions existed (old push_service.dart:31-34, :56-57) but initialize ran only once at start (old main.dart:219-222) and resume only cleared the tray (old :269).

v2_where: All call sites are shared and run before or outside the look switch: main.dart:286-291, :337-343, :379-383; onboarding PermissionOverlay in v2 scope still calls _onPermDone (main.dart:512-515 -> :425-434); Profile -> Permissions v2 view uses the same onAllowAll -> requestAllPermissionsAndReport (features/profile/permissions_screen.dart:98-115) -> permission_service.dart:63-66.

situation: The customer scans a document; the scan must not overwrite the licence group or licence expiry the customer entered, the back of the licence must not change the number or expiry, the back of the ID writes only the address, and only groups A, A1, A2, AM, B are accepted from a scan.
old_where: Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/features/documents/document_provider.dart:546 (_validLicenseGroups = A, A1, A2, AM, B; N is never taken from a scan), :740-747 (_parseLicenseGroups filter), :566-733 saveOcrToProfile: :570 (no user -> nothing), :589-606 (reads current profile; hasProfileGroup), :608-635 licence back (number compared only -> warning; group only when profile has none :626-629; never number/expiry), :636-667 licence front (number written :638-642, group only when empty :643-646, license_expiry only when empty :656-659, license_verified_until always :661), :670-689 ID/passport back (street/city/zip only), :690-718 ID/passport front (id_number + validity). Same rules in 70a94933 (diff changes only the warning texts and the save-error message). IMPORTANT correction: the scan DOES overwrite full_name and date_of_birth on every side (:581-585), license_number on the licence front (:638-642) and id_number on the ID front (:698) - only licence group and licence expiry are protected.
customer_sees: The scan result screen lists the read fields; a licence-number mismatch between front and back or a failed save is appended as a warning (document_scanner_screen.dart:289-294). The protection itself is invisible.
server: no (the customer may write these columns directly: _trg_guard_customer_profile_columns only protects admin columns, SUPABASE_BACKEND_STATE_4.md:45; the server re-checks group/expiry later in door-code release, trg_release_codes_on_profile_verify :205, and in booking RPCs)
v2_where: Shared callers only: features/documents/document_scanner_screen.dart:289-294 (result passed to v2 ScanResultV2 message at :1141-1144, shown in features/documents/v2/scan_states_v2.dart ScanResultV2) and features/documents/documents_screen.dart:436-452 (_scanAndSave, used by both looks at :377). No v2 file writes to profiles (grep of from('profiles') in features/*/v2 and core/v2 = no hit).
evidence: saveOcrToProfile has no MgV2 branch; both scan paths call it with the same docType/stepKey; the v2 result view shows the same message string including the warning (scan_states_v2.dart: message rendered via mgStripEmoji(message)). Note (both looks, also in 4.1.3 at old documents_screen.dart:288): the documents-screen path discards the returned warning, so a licence-number mismatch is shown only in the step-by-step scanner.
visible_v2: silent (same as before); the mismatch warning keeps the same text in the v2 result screen
fix_idea: No v2 fix needed. For the inventory record: state the exact protected fields (group, expiry) and the overwritten ones (name, date of birth, licence number, ID number). Optional: show the save warning also on the documents-screen path.

situation: The customer presses system back (or swipes back) on a screen with nothing underneath (opened from a tab, a notification or a deep link); instead of closing the app it goes to a fixed parent screen, after the screen's own back handler (confirmation dialog) gets the first chance.
old_where: NOT present in 4.1.3 (core/widgets/mg_back.dart does not exist in 70a94933; go_router 13 closed the app). On this branch: Motogo-app-main/motogo-app-flutter/lib/core/widgets/mg_back.dart:11-75 (mgBackParent: /payment, /success, /payment-result -> /reservations; /booking, /moto -> /search; /reservations/{id}/edit -> detail; /reservations/{id} -> /reservations; /sos/* -> /sos, /sos/done -> /; /checkout -> /cart; /cart, /voucher -> /shop; /docs, /messages, /shop, /invoices, /contracts, /permissions, /loyalty -> /profile; / and /login -> null = app closes), :128-149 (_onBack: offline overlay first :131, normal pop first :138, shell inner maybePop gives the screen's PopScope its chance :139-143), :151-168 (PopScope canPop false while a parent exists).
customer_sees: The parent screen opens instead of the app closing; on screens with their own BackButtonListener (payment_screen.dart:1504, payment_confirmation_screen.dart:284, payment_result_screen.dart:215, shop_checkout_screen.dart:680, register/reset) their own rule runs first.
v2_where: Old shell core/app_shell.dart:91 and v2 shell core/v2/shell/app_shell_v2.dart:231 both wrap content in MgBackGuard(shell: true); routes outside the shell are wrapped regardless of look in core/router.dart:271-363 and core/widgets/route_error_page.dart:29, :42. v2 entry points: Android back / predictive back (PopScope + BackButtonListener, same widget), iOS swipe (v2 uses MaterialPage, router.dart:161-164; the swipe only pops when there is history, otherwise PopScope canPop:false blocks it), MgEdgeBack on register/reset (core/v2/gestures/mg_edge_back.dart:7-16) forwards to the same onBack as the screen arrow.
evidence: One shared widget is used by both shells and by all non-shell routes; mgBackParent has no look dependency. Visible back arrows are screen-specific and do not use mgBackParent in either look (example: booking form arrow -> bike detail, system back without history -> /search), so the two can differ, identically in both looks.
fix_idea: No v2 fix needed. Optional: align mgBackParent('/booking') with bookingFormBack (bike detail when a bike is chosen) so arrow and system back agree.
